mapping_json.fidelity_notes: THE PUREST CHARGE-AND-DETONATE (mech_note verbatim): channel to grow a circle through 10 stages from the player position, release an enormous fire nova at full size; rooted while channeling (dossier skill_loop/skill_geometry). This maps NEARLY LOSSLESSLY: (1) circle geometry (§6 expanding circle; self-origin filled nova — circle over ring since it is a filled growing disc from self, not a hollow burst-ring); (2) the 10-stage-channel-then-release IS the accumulator-discharge primitive (charge_stack_sub_shape=accumulator, accumulator_max=10 = the 10 stages, fill on-passive-tick = the channel builds a stage per tick, discharge_threshold=10 = release at full — all engine-verified enums, resource_economy.py:70-74,143); (3) the rooted channel-maintain = persistent_condition_shape=tick-cost (mana-per-stage). fire->burn (probe 'burn'; Shaper of Flames guaranteed-ignite variant). T4 TEMPORAL_CHARGE (the stage-charge engine, §5 charge/stack) + GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE (the grow-then-detonate-one-big-nova reading). CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — t4 routed from core identity (stage-charge-then-detonate engine) + probe (mana-spend, rooted, self-origin, large-zone) per fallback. The 'earlier release = smaller/weaker' is the native accumulator-below-threshold behavior (discharge before cap = fewer stages consumed) — a clean match. The rooted-vulnerability is a behavioral property of the tick-cost channel; the Totem variant (avoids player vulnerability) is a delivery swap noted in variants, not the dominant self-cast identity.
